_comment: Matches this gate has been told not to fail on.
THE VALUE IS NEVER STORED, and neither is its location. Each entry is a
salted hash of the matched text and nothing else. This file is committed to
a PUBLIC repository: recording which document a hash came from would be a
map to unredacted material, which is exactly what the gate's own reporting
refuses to print. To find an entry, run the gate locally with --detail.
WHAT AN ENTRY MEANS. That this match does not stop the build today. It is
NOT a finding that the content is fine, and it is not a decision anyone has
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE. Every high-severity match found on 2026-07-31
was resolved by REMOVING the document or withholding the page, not by being
listed here: Social Security numbers, dates of birth, and the driver's
licence and residence data that travelled with them. Those categories stand
at zero. If one ever appears in this file, something has gone wrong with how
CLEARING AN ENTRY means redacting the source PDF and rebuilding the corpus,
or withdrawing the document. Deleting the line only makes the build red.

policy.note: A test asserts this file contains no entry for those patterns.

accepted.reason: Present before the gate was armed. Accepted so the gate can fail closed on anything NEW. Not a finding that the content is beyond review.
